name: Find Oasis
body:
School divination; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 2, druid 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard l

CASTING

Casting Time 1 full round
Components V, S, M (pit of a date, covered with sand)

EFFECT

Range 5,000 ft. + 500 ft./level
Area a circle, centered on caster, with a radius of 5,000 ft. + 500 ft./level
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell is similar to locate object, but specifically tailored for determining the location of oases. When the spell is cast, you receive a mental image of any oases in the area of the spell’s effect as well as their general direction and distance. You can move normally while maintaining concentration on this spell.
